lines.en: I call up Makoto and the two of us make plans to meet up in the park for a little while before she has to head back home for work.
lines.zh: 我给 Makoto 打电话，我俩约好在公园待一会儿，之后她得回家上班。

lines.en: When I get there, she greets me with a plastic bag full of assorted soft drinks that the two of us proceed to consume while hanging around the fountain.
lines.zh: 我到那儿时，她用一个装满各种软饮的塑料袋迎接我，我俩就着喷泉边喝边晃。

lines.en: At one point, she pulls a coin from her pocket and tosses it into the water. But when I ask her what she wished for, she just shrugs.
lines.zh: 某一刻，她从口袋里摸出一枚硬币扔进水里。可我问她许了什么愿，她只是耸耸肩。

lines.en: She says there isn't anything she wants. Other than for me to stop torturing her, that is. But if that was possible, I would have done it by now.
lines.zh: 她说她什么都不缺。除了让我别再折磨她——不过如果那有可能，我早就做到了。

lines.en: This compulsive behavior of mine to make her life a living hell no longer mirrors the inverse of my feelings for her. I am no child kicking sand into the eyes of another.
lines.zh: 我这种非要把她的生活变成地狱的强迫行为，已经不再是我对她感情的镜像反面了。我不再是那个往别人眼里踢沙子的小孩。

lines.en: I am a man who has habitual rough sex with a girl who could go on to do great things if she could only focus on the outside world rather than what I elect to fill her with.
lines.zh: 我是一个有习惯跟一个女孩粗暴做爱的男人——而那个女孩本可以成就大事，只要她能专注外面的世界，而不是专注我选择灌进她身体里的东西。

lines.en: But perhaps it's for the best that she doesn't.
lines.zh: 但也许她不专注反而是最好的。

lines.en: Perhaps her reluctance to omit me from her daily thought pattern helps make me human- if one could even call me that.
lines.zh: 也许正是她不肯把我从日常思绪里剔除，才让我还算是个人——如果「人」这个词还能用在我身上的话。

lines.en: I feel like she would. But I also feel like she'd be lying.
lines.zh: 我觉得她会。但我也觉得她在撒谎。

lines.en: And even more than that, I feel as if she may be losing touch with what exactly that means.
lines.zh: 而且不止如此，我觉得她可能正在失去对那究竟意味着什么的把握。
